name: GDA Kraft Booking – Vacation Rental Calendar & iCal Sync
author: globaldigitalagency

sections.description:
GDA Kraft Booking (public beta) adds a booking calendar and a booking engine to WordPress for holiday homes, vacation rentals, guest houses, B&Bs (chambres d’hôtes), villas and small hotels. Turn your WordPress site into a vacation rental website that takes direct bookings, and keep your availability in sync with Airbnb, Booking.com and Vrbo through iCal. Every feature below works without an account, a subscription or a “Pro” version.

Languages: available in 6 languages: English (source language), French, Spanish, Italian, German and Brazilian Portuguese. German uses the informal “du”; sites set to German (formal) get a formal “Sie” version. Translations are bundled with the plugin and follow the site language automatically; the admin screens follow each user’s own profile language. Regional variants (for example fr_CA, es_MX, de_CH) use the closest bundled translation, and translations from translate.wordpress.org take priority when available. Guest e-mails are sent in the language of the booking. Any text shown to visitors can also be renamed in Texts and labels.

Features

  • Accommodations and units: photos, property types, amenities, adults / children capacity per unit.
  • Rates: nightly price, seasons and rate rules, weekend prices, minimum stay, length-of-stay discounts, coupons, extra services and cleaning fees.
  • Tourist tax: per person and per night, with child exemption and a cap on nights.
  • Availability calendar: closed days, arrival / departure days, buffers between stays.
  • Airbnb calendar sync (iCal): one export URL per unit, import of external calendars (Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo or any iCal channel), refreshed every 15 minutes.
  • Bookings: manual bookings and booking requests: the guest sends a request, you confirm it and collect the payment offline (bank transfer, on site).
  • Guest side: search form, results, booking form, price breakdown, guest portal with messages and documents.
  • Emails: confirmation, request received, reminders before arrival, review requests.
  • Texts and labels: rename any text (for example “Guests” to “Persons”) without code.

Who is it for

  • Owners of one or a few holiday rentals who want a direct booking site.
  • Guest houses, B&Bs and small hotels that want guest house booking or B&B booking on their own site, with several rooms or units.
  • Web designers building accommodation sites with Divi 5, Elementor or the block editor.

Why direct bookings

Listing sites bring visibility, but each booking made through them is subject to their fees and rules. A direct booking page on your own site lets returning guests book you directly, under your own conditions. iCal keeps your calendar in sync with the listing sites you keep, so the same dates are not sold twice.

Divi 5, block editor and Elementor

The same booking components are available as Divi 5 modules, blocks for the block editor (Gutenberg) and Elementor widgets. Bricks support is coming.

Website templates (optional)

Kraft Booking › Templates shows the Kraft GDA website templates (holiday rentals, agencies and platforms, appointments) for the block editor, Divi 5 and Elementor, right inside WordPress: click “See the templates” to browse them, filter by sector and builder, open a demo in a new tab. To install one, create a free Kraft GDA account or sign in without leaving WordPress (a 6-digit code is sent by email), or connect with the browser. Free templates install directly; paid templates (19,90 €, VAT not applicable, art. 293 B of the French CGI) are bought in a Stripe Checkout window and the installation starts as soon as the purchase is confirmed. A step-by-step wizard then installs the template: free themes and plugins it needs from WordPress.org, a new site or pages added without overwriting yours, then one-click removal of the demo content. Templates are data only: no code is downloaded (see External services).

Your data stays in WordPress

Bookings, guests and prices are stored in your own database. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you connect a Kraft GDA account.

Kraft GDA (free account) unlocks

An optional free Kraft GDA account gives access to the separate GDA Kraft Booking Connect add-on (downloaded from your Kraft GDA account, not from WordPress.org): online payments with Kraft Pay (Stripe), deposits and automatic balance collection, a front-end management dashboard, design modules, custom fields, a multilingual switcher and an AI assistant.

These hosted features are services run by Kraft GDA (SaaS): they require a Kraft GDA account and the Connect add-on. The plugin and the account are free. Online payments made through Kraft Pay carry a service fee paid by the traveler: 0.45 % until 30 June 2027, then 0.9 %. The fee applies only to online payments; offline payments and booking requests are never charged.

Beta

This is a public beta (0.x versions). Please report any issue in the support forum.

External services

The plugin works without any external service. It only contacts the services below in the situations described.

Kraft GDA (https://app.global-digital-agency.fr) — optional free account, used only if you click “Connect my Kraft GDA account (free)” or “I already have an account” on the Getting started or Kraft GDA screen, or “Send me a code” / “Sign in with the browser” in the Templates screen.

  • When: only when you click one of these buttons to connect the site, and when you click “Disconnect”. This plugin makes no background request to Kraft GDA and sends no statistics or usage data.
  • Data sent: site address and name, administrator email address (or the email address you type in the Templates screen), plugin, WordPress and PHP versions, admin language, your acceptance of the Kraft GDA terms of use, and a one-time connection code (the 6-digit code you received by email, or a code returned to WordPress by the browser).
  • An account is created only when you enter the 6-digit code sent to your email address (if no account uses that address yet); it has no password until you set one with “Forgot password” on Kraft GDA.
  • Terms of use: https://app.global-digital-agency.fr/cgu
  • Privacy policy: https://app.global-digital-agency.fr/confidentialite

Kraft GDA template library (https://app.global-digital-agency.fr/api/v1/market/) — optional website templates in Kraft Booking › Templates. Every other feature of the plugin works without it.

  • When, on a site that is not connected: nothing is requested when you open the Templates screen. Only after you click “See the templates” does WordPress request the public, read-only catalogue (/api/v1/market/public/templates); the template thumbnails are then loaded by your browser from the same server. Changing a filter requests the catalogue again.
  • When, on a connected site: when an administrator opens the Templates screen (list of templates of the account and their thumbnails), when they install a template (signed manifest and files of the chosen template, then an installation report), and when they click “Buy” for a paid template (creation of the payment, then a check of the account’s templates every 3 seconds for at most 10 minutes, to start the installation as soon as the purchase is confirmed). Nothing is requested on other screens or in the background.
  • Data sent: for the public catalogue, only the admin language and the filters you choose (no site address, no identifier). On a connected site: the site identifier with a request signature, the chosen template and builder, the plugin edition and version, WordPress and PHP versions and the admin language; after an installation, the number of items created. No visitor, guest or booking data.
  • What is downloaded: data only (page layouts in JSON, texts, images, fonts and settings), described by a manifest signed by Kraft GDA (Ed25519) and checked file by file (SHA-256) before use. This plugin never downloads or runs code from this service: the themes and plugins a template needs (Elementor, Hello Elementor, Twenty Twenty-Five) are installed from WordPress.org only, and Divi (commercial theme) must already be installed.
  • Demos: the “Preview” button opens the template demo (https://demo.global-digital-agency.fr) in a new browser tab.
  • Terms of use: https://app.global-digital-agency.fr/cgu
  • Privacy policy: https://app.global-digital-agency.fr/confidentialite

Stripe Checkout (https://checkout.stripe.com) — payment page for a paid template, used only if you click “Buy” in the Templates screen.

  • When: only after that click; the payment page opens in a separate browser window and is created by Kraft GDA for your Kraft GDA account. WordPress never receives or stores card data.
  • Data sent: what you enter on the Stripe page; Kraft GDA sends Stripe the price, the template name and the email address of your Kraft GDA account.
  • Terms of use: https://stripe.com/legal/ssa
  • Privacy policy: https://stripe.com/privacy

OpenStreetMap / Nominatim (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org) — optional place suggestions in the “City” field of the search module. Disabled by default: nothing is sent unless an administrator enables place suggestions in Kraft Booking › Réglages › Services externes (Settings › External services).

  • When: only once enabled, when a visitor types at least 3 characters in that field (requests go from your server; results are cached for 24 hours).
  • Data sent: the text typed, the site language, and your site address in the User-Agent header (required by the Nominatim usage policy). No visitor IP address or other personal data is forwarded.
  • Terms of use: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/
  • Privacy policy: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy

iCal calendars you add (Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo or any other channel) — calendar synchronisation.

  • When: every 15 minutes, only for the calendar URLs you entered in an accommodation.
  • Data sent: a standard HTTP request to the URL you provided (no booking or guest data).
  • Terms and privacy: those of the channel that provides the calendar URL.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate GDA Kraft Booking from Plugins › Add New.
  2. Create your first accommodation in Kraft Booking › Hébergements (Accommodations), then set its units, rates and availability in Planning & tarifs.
  3. Add the booking blocks (or Divi modules / Elementor widgets) to your pages.
  4. Optional: to accept online payments, create a free Kraft GDA account from Kraft Booking › Kraft GDA, then install the Connect add-on from that account.
sections.faq:
How does the Airbnb calendar sync work?

Each unit has an iCal export URL: paste it into the calendar settings of each channel. Then paste each channel’s iCal URL into the unit. Imported calendars are refreshed every 15 minutes and their dates are blocked on your site. iCal only carries dates, not prices or guest details.

Can I build a vacation rental website with it?

Yes. Create your rentals, then add the search, results, availability calendar and booking form to your pages (blocks, Divi 5 modules or Elementor widgets). Guests see live availability and the full price, and send their booking from your own site. It works with any theme.

Does it work for a guest house or a B&B?

Yes. One property can hold several rooms (units), each with its own capacity, rates and calendar. Guests pick their dates and the room they want, which covers guest house booking and B&B booking on your own site.

Can I get double bookings?

On your site, a stay is held for a few minutes while the guest completes the form (15 by default) and overlapping dates are refused. Between your site and other channels, iCal is not instant: a booking made elsewhere is seen at the next refresh. For dates in high demand, confirm booking requests manually.

Can it handle the tourist tax (taxe de séjour)?

Yes. Add a tourist tax rule per accommodation: amount per person and per night, child exemption, maximum number of nights, included in the price or added to it. You set the amounts that apply to you; the plugin does not provide official rates.

Does it work with Divi?

Yes, with Divi 5: the booking components appear as native modules in the Visual Builder. With Divi 4, use the plugin’s shortcodes instead.

Is it free? What are the fees?

The plugin is free, with no paid version and no locked feature. Booking requests and offline payments carry no fee. Only online payments through Kraft Pay (optional Connect add-on and Kraft GDA account) carry a service fee paid by the traveler: 0.45 % until 30 June 2027, then 0.9 %.

Do I need an account?

No. A free Kraft GDA account is needed only for the hosted services of the Connect add-on (online payments, management dashboard, etc.).

How do guests pay without the add-on?

Guests send a booking request, or you create the booking yourself. You confirm it and collect the payment offline, for example by bank transfer or on arrival.

Which languages are available?

Five: English, French, Spanish, Italian and German, bundled with the plugin. The site language sets the language of visitor-facing texts, guest e-mails are sent in the language of the booking, and in the admin, each user sees the plugin in the language of their own profile. Visitor-facing texts can also be renamed in Texts and labels.

Can I manage several rentals or rooms?

Yes. Create as many accommodations as you need, each with its own units, rates, calendar and iCal links.
sections.changelog:
0.3.2

  • Improved: “Connect my site” now connects with a 6-digit code sent by email, which works on every site (cache or security plugins, www / non-www address, expired sessions). Signing in through the browser stays available as a secondary link. After connecting, you return to the screen you started from.

0.3.1

  • Fix: when the browser connection to Kraft GDA cannot be completed on return (request lost by a cache or security plugin, www / non-www address, expired link), the plugin now opens the connection with a 6-digit code sent by email instead of only showing an error.

0.3.0 (beta)

  • New: Templates screen (Kraft Booking › Templates) with a step-by-step installation wizard for the Kraft GDA website templates (block editor, Divi 5, Elementor). Templates are data only, described by a signed manifest and checked file by file; required free themes and plugins come from WordPress.org.
  • New: template shop inside the wizard. “See the templates” shows the public catalogue (sector and builder filters, free or 19,90 €, demo in a new tab) without connecting first; nothing is requested before that click. “Install” on a site that is not connected opens an inline panel to create a free Kraft GDA account or sign in with a 6-digit code sent by email (terms of use to accept, new code after 60 seconds), or with the browser. Paid templates are bought in a Stripe Checkout window; the wizard starts the installation as soon as the purchase is confirmed.
  • New: “Install a template in 4 steps” guide at the top of the plugin’s screens only (full on the Kraft Booking dashboard, Templates and Getting started screens, compact elsewhere and in the installation wizard), collapsible per user, with a “What’s new” slide shown once per version. Accessible carousel (pause button, keyboard, reduced motion), local images only, no external request, no tracking. It replaces the templates notice.
  • Fix: on narrow phones (360 to 390 px), booking widgets, calendars, the date and guest pickers and appointment cards no longer overflow the screen, including with themes that keep buttons on one line (for example Hello Elementor).
  • Translations: Brazilian Portuguese added. German now uses the informal “du”; the formal “Sie” version is kept for German (formal). French, Spanish and Italian updated for the new texts.

0.2.2 (beta)

  • Fix: Divi 5 presets now apply to the Availability calendar, Coupon and Reviews modules (their default design values no longer override the preset).
  • Fix: on block themes (for example Twenty Twenty-Five), accommodation pages use the theme’s own template instead of the legacy WordPress header and footer.
  • Guest portal: the accent color follows the module setting, or the theme’s accent color, instead of a fixed indigo.
  • Readme: new screenshots, clearer description of Airbnb calendar sync, direct booking and guest house / B&B use.

0.2.1 (beta)

  • Fix: the Kraft Booking blocks did not appear in the block editor. All blocks can be inserted again (search, results, booking form, availability calendar, guest portal).
  • Fix: guests now see a translated booking status (for example “Request awaiting approval”) instead of an internal code, in the guest portal, on the confirmation page and in e-mails.
  • Readme: the plugin is available in 5 languages (English, French, Spanish, Italian, German).

0.2.0 (beta)

  • Translations: English source strings; French, Spanish, Italian and German included; admin follows each user’s language.
  • Regional variants (for example fr_BE, fr_CA, es_MX, de_AT, de_CH, it_CH) use the bundled French, Spanish, German or Italian translation. Translations from translate.wordpress.org take priority when available.
  • Guest e-mails are sent in the language of the booking.

0.1.2 (beta)

  • New: “Getting started” screen, opened once after the first activation (never on bulk or network activation).
  • New: one dismissible notice, only on the plugin’s screens. No request to Kraft GDA before you click Connect.

0.1.1 (beta)

  • Fix: an automatic balance charge could be attempted after the balance was settled offline or partly paid.

0.1.0 (beta)

  • Initial public beta.
